approval_evidence: User explicitly approved all notes and requested conversion into the official Second Brain, followed by web and desktop applications.
ordered_outcomes: Promote all 645 registered notes and their registry entries to canonical.
Build a private local-first web application over the canonical corpus.
Build a private local-first desktop application sharing the same renderer and data index.
Run content, build, browser and desktop smoke tests before reporting done.

acceptance.web: full-text search, filters, note reader, Markdown, Mermaid, code, relationships, favorites and responsive layout
acceptance.desktop: secure Electron shell, local index loading, navigation protection and the same reader experience
acceptance.privacy: no public deployment and no remote source dependency
acceptance.regression: Second Brain validation, app tests and production build pass

non_goals: Publishing copyrighted books or note bodies to a public host
Adding authentication, synchronization or cloud persistence
Claiming production stability before owner use
